cr_data.provenance: (Alfred Stieglitz, New York, NY); Lewis Mumford, New York, NY, gift, 1927; Alison Mumford Morss, New  York, NY, bequest, 1973; Sotheby's, New York, NY, sale no. 5721, lot no. 244, 25 May 1988; (Cambridge Fine Arts, Cambridge, Massachusetts) (Source: Lynes, 1999)
remarks_1999: Not recorded Downtown Gallery Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks. Whitney Archive indicates, "Painted 1923: Note: Miss O'Keeffe says this was sold. Does not remember owner. Possibly Sterns or Mumford." (Source: Lynes, 1999)

titles.notes: Source of title: relationship of image to cat. no. 435.
titles.title: Four Dark Red Oak Leaves

description: Four burgundy oak leaves meet at the center of this composition. Behind the burgundy leaves, a few others in shades of brown and bright red swirl in semiabstract patterns.
imageCaption: Image courtesy of a scanned transparency made for Georgia O'Keeffe: Catalogue Raisonné. This image has not been color proofed and may differ from the original. It will be replaced when newer photography becomes available.
